# Archived UI snapshots — DO NOT EDIT

These are three earlier, incomplete copies of the same Next.js app. They are kept
only for history. Nothing here is built, served, or wired to the backend.

**The live application is:**

    frontend-workspace/Lite - Next.js Base/Lite Alert Review — Next.js Base/

Editing files in this folder has no effect on the running site.

Their only unique change (a full-bleed AppShell layout, made in the Alert
History copy) was ported into the live app on 2026-08-13.
